bpy.ops.image.open.notes: 5.0: data path is the canonical loader; ops path is editor-only.

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add.notes: 5.0: ops path is canonical for primitives; switch to data for custom topologies.

bpy.ops.object.delete.notes: 5.0: data path is deterministic; ops path depends on selection state.

bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply.notes: Data path requires depsgraph evaluation; ops path is simpler in v1.

bpy.ops.render.render.notes: Render is fundamentally context-bound; no equivalent data path.

bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile.notes: Save is window-manager-bound; no equivalent data path.
